name: John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc.
summary: John B. Sanfilippo & Son, Inc., through its subsidiary, JBSS Ventures, LLC, engages in the process and distribution of tree nuts and peanuts in the United States. The company offers raw and processed nuts, including almonds, pecans, peanuts, walnuts, cashews, macadamia nuts, pistachios, pine nuts, and filberts in various styles and seasonings; and bar product line, including chewy granola, fruit and grain, sweet and salty, dipped chewy granola, crunchy, energy, fiber, nut, fig, and protein bars. It also offers peanut butter in various sizes and varieties; salad toppings, dried fruit and chocolate, and yogurt coated products; recipe ingredients; bulk food products; sunflower kernels, pepitas,…
